synonyms.title: synonyms
synonyms.text: opposite contradictory contrary antithetical mean being so far apart as to be or seem irreconcilable. opposite applies to things in sharp contrast or in conflict. contradictory applies to two things that completely negate each other so that if one is true or valid the other must be untrue or invalid. contrary implies extreme divergence or diametrical opposition. antithetical stresses clear and unequivocal diametrical opposition.
examples: made contradictory predictions about whether the market would rise or fall
